name: The Strawberry Sunset Party Box
description_html:
Ingredients: 100+ stems of pink roses and lilies, alstroemeria, orange bi-color carnations, and eucalyptus

Best For: Hosting a bouquet bar for your besties, brunch tablescapes, or making your own bouquets for people you love

Pro Tip: Order your DIY Party Box to arrive two days before your event to give them time to open up from bud form. They’re straight from the farm, so they’re super fresh. 

What to Expect: DIY Party Boxes do not arrive arranged. Rather you will receive a box of loose stems, ready for some DIY fun. 
How it ships: These will arrive in an extra-large box (approx. 38"x12"x5") and weigh approximately 13lbs. The box will contain multiple bunches of stems, carefully wrapped so they are protected during transport. 
Suggested Prep: We recommend planning ahead, as processing and arranging your stems into arrangements or installations takes time and space. 

  1. Remove all flowers from packaging. 
  2. Process your flowers by hydrating them in a cool space. Once hydrated, trim the stems at a 45-degree angle and remove any leaves that’ll fall below the water line. 
  3. Start arranging!  

Learn more about processing flowers here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FypUVkPsyMo&t=5s
